description.en: GLM Coding Plan via BigModel OAuth plus the ZCode Start Plan as its own Claude-protocol provider entry. Sign-in mints the coding-plan API key; the gift meters per model bucket.
description.zh: BigModel OAuth 登录接入 GLM 编程套餐；体验套餐（ZCode Start Plan）作为独立供应商条目，仅支持 Claude 协议，按模型分别计量。登录后铸造编程套餐 API Key。

description.en: Authorize your Zhipu BigModel account in the browser; sign-in finishes automatically — no callback URL to copy.
description.zh: 在浏览器登录智谱 BigModel 完成授权，页面会自动检测并收尾，无需复制任何地址。
